verdict.rationale: GitBook ships AI features (GitBook Agent and Assistant), so it is fair to ask whether it can act as an MCP client. Every MCP item in the pack, however, describes the server role: GitBook's own MCP server for external clients like Claude Code and Cursor, and MCP servers for published docs. Nothing shows GitBook connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
